DEEPCRAFTModelConverter.title: DEEPCRAFT™ Model Converter
DEEPCRAFTModelConverter.description: Converts, optimizes and validates AI models for Infineon MCUs
DEEPCRAFTModelConverter.long_description: The DEEPCRAFT™ Model Converter is a software application that supports the Bring Your Own Model concept (BYOM), which allows users to bring their own AI model and run it on edge devices. This application helps machine learning engineers work more efficiently, by streamlining the processes for running their models on their target hardware. Models are converted so they can run on the edge. Models are optimized, which means they will become highly compact and high-performance models, designed to run on Infineon MCUs. Models are validated with a dataset to check that the generated code matches the performance in the original models. Validation is done on the desktop, it has an easy-to-use Graphical User Interface (GUI) and runs on Windows, Linux and Mac. It also includes a Command Line Interface (CLI) to enable integration into Continuous Integration (CI)/Continuous Delivery (CD) pipelines and workflows.

Solutions.title: Solutions
Solutions.description: Production-ready DEEPCRAFT™ Ready Models and edge AI software solutions from Infineon — the fastest way to production in the Hub.
Solutions.long_description: The Solutions section features fully developed models and applications you can download, evaluate on supported hardware, and integrate into your product—without training a model from scratch. Solutions skip the full model development cycle and give you field-proven models already optimized for Infineon MCUs. Each solution includes metadata for sensors, target devices, compatible kits, application domains, and performance metrics (memory usage, inference time, and power where available). Solutions are maintained by Infineon and are not open for community contribution.

steps.text: Open the DEEPCRAFT™ AI Hub and browse the Solutions section, or filter by sensor, device, kit, or application domain.
Select a solution to view its description, compatible hardware, and performance metrics.
Product details, use cases, and documentation on Infineon.com.
Download the evaluation package or open an interactive demo (where available).
Most Ready Models offer an evaluation download through Infineon Software Tools. The DEEPCRAFT™ Voice Assistant also provides an online demo.
Confirm the solution supports your target kit and device (PSOC™ 6, PSOC™ Edge, or radar sensor) in the Hub metadata.
Download the Ready Model evaluation tool or software bundle from the solution's Try Today link.
Use a supported evaluation kit such as the following:
Follow the product page or evaluation package instructions to run inference on hardware, and review published metrics (memory, inference time, power) to confirm the model fits your constraints.
For DEEPCRAFT™ Voice Assistant and Audio Enhancement, use the product pages for user guides, demo firmware, and setup instructions.

boxes.heading: How to deploy
boxes.text: Ready Models are designed for integration into commercial products on Infineon MCUs and offer the shortest path from evaluation to production.

steps.text: Validate accuracy and performance on the kit and sensor configuration closest to your product.
Use the evaluation package and product documentation to embed the model in your ModusToolbox™ application on PSOC™ 6 or PSOC™ Edge.
Use published metrics as a baseline; tune thresholds, sensor placement, and power modes for your use case.

boxes.heading: What is Edge AI?
boxes.text: Edge AI refers to running machine learning inference directly on embedded devices—microcontrollers, sensors, and local gateways—rather than sending data to the cloud. Processing happens where the data is captured: on a microphone, camera, radar sensor, or IMU inside your product. This approach brings several advantages for embedded and IoT applications:

steps.text: Decisions are made in real time, without waiting for a network round trip.
Sensor data stays on the device; sensitive audio, vision, and motion data does not need to leave the product.
Inference works even when connectivity is limited or unavailable.
Models optimized for MCUs can run continuously on battery-powered devices.

boxes.heading: Tools
boxes.text: The Tools section covers software for the full edge AI workflow—from model development and training to conversion and deployment on Infineon devices.

steps.text: Infineon's development platform for building custom Edge AI models. Bring your own sensor data or start from a Studio Accelerator. Supports classification, regression, and object detection across audio, vision, motion, and other sensor domains.
Converts, optimizes, and validates your own models (BYOM) for Infineon MCUs. Available with a GUI and CLI for desktop and CI/CD workflows on PSOC™ 6 and PSOC™ Edge targets.

boxes.heading: Solutions
boxes.text: Solutions are production-ready Infineon offerings you can download and evaluate on supported hardware without building from scratch. They include DEEPCRAFT™ Ready Models for specific detection tasks (baby cry, cough, siren, snore, factory alarm, direction of arrival, gesture detection, and fall detection), and full software solutions such as DEEPCRAFT™ Voice Assistant and DEEPCRAFT™ Audio Enhancement on PSOC™ Edge. Each solution lists compatible kits and devices, performance metrics, and links to product details and evaluation downloads on Infineon.com.

boxes.heading: Accelerators
boxes.text: Accelerators are deep learning starter projects designed for DEEPCRAFT™ Studio. Each project includes labeled data and a Studio project file (.improj) ready to open in DEEPCRAFT™ Studio for faster model development. They cover use cases such as keyword detection, fall detection, human activity recognition, battery state estimation, and vision tasks like presence or road-user detection.

steps.text: Build your Accelerator in DEEPCRAFT™ Studio, then submit it with the dedicated Pull Request tool. It validates your project layout, helps create the metadata file, and opens a pull request for Infineon review. Once merged, your Accelerator is published on the Hub and in DEEPCRAFT™ Studio.

boxes.heading: Model Zoo for PSOC
boxes.text: The DEEPCRAFT™ Model Zoo for PSOC contains machine learning models deployable on PSOC™ Edge and related devices. Projects span vision (YOLO, MobileNet, segmentation, pose), audio, radar, and sensor fusion. Most projects offer two paths: flash a pre-built .hex firmware with ModusToolbox™ Programmer for immediate evaluation, or integrate embedded deployment artifacts from the fw/ folder into your own ModusToolbox™ application.

steps.text: Prepare a deployment project and submit it with the dedicated Pull Request tool. After Infineon review and merge, your project is published on the AI Hub. Partners should contact Infineon alongside the pull request to coordinate branding.

boxes.heading: Model Zoo for AURIX
boxes.text: The DEEPCRAFT™ Model Zoo for AURIX is a collection of machine learning models and tools for developing, training, and deploying AI on AURIX™ microcontrollers—aimed at automotive and industrial workloads. Example projects include keyword detection, image classification (MobileNet, MNIST), anomaly detection, remaining useful life prediction, and AI-enhanced PID control. Models are converted to C via ONNX and validated with tools such as ONNX2C, AURIX GCC, and QEMU. Contributions are managed by Infineon Automotive and are not open for general community submission through the Hub for now.

boxes.heading: Deploying on Infineon hardware
boxes.text: AI Hub models and solutions are validated on Infineon evaluation kits. Each project lists compatible kits and devices in its metadata—check these before you start. On PSOC™ targets, most Model Zoo projects let you flash a pre-built .hex file with ModusToolbox™ Programmer, or integrate deployment artifacts from the project's fw/ folder. AURIX™ projects typically use the repository's Docker-based environment and AURIX™ Development Studio. To run AI Hub content on hardware, you need the matching evaluation kit — order boards from Infineon or authorized distributors:

steps.text: Vision and ML models with Arm® Ethos-U55 NPU acceleration (KIT_PSE84_EVAL).
Compact Edge AI kit with camera, microphone, radar, and IMU sensors (KIT_PSE84_AI).
Audio, motion, and radar sensing for DEEPCRAFT™ Studio and Ready Models (CY8CKIT-062S2-AI).
General-purpose PSOC™ 6 development platform (CY8CKIT-062-BLE).
60 GHz radar with PSOC™ 6 for presence and entrance-counting use cases (KIT_CSK_BGT60TR13C).
AURIX™ TC3xx development board (KIT_A2G_TC375_LITE).
AURIX™ TC4xx development board (KIT_A3G_TC4D7_LITE).

Partners.title: Partners
Partners.description: Trusted design partners contribute branded, benchmarked, production-ready edge AI content for Infineon hardware.
Partners.long_description: The DEEPCRAFT™ AI Hub brings together Infineon content and contributions from trusted design partners. Partner projects are published with partner branding, benchmark data, and deployment resources so you can evaluate and integrate third-party edge AI solutions on Infineon hardware. Partner entries are identified by the partner logo and website link in each project's metadata. Browse partner content to find models and solutions optimized for Infineon platforms by ecosystem experts who bring specialized domain knowledge, deployment experience, and production-ready implementations.

boxes.heading: Become a Partner
boxes.text: Infineon welcomes design partners and ecosystem contributors who have deployable edge AI content for PSOC™ and other open Infineon platforms. Approved submissions are published on the DEEPCRAFT™ AI Hub after review.

boxes.heading: What You Can Contribute
boxes.text: Choose the repository that matches your content type:

steps.text: DEEPCRAFT™ Studio starter projects with sample data and a project file (.improj) for classification, regression, or object detection workflows.
Deployable models with pre-built firmware (.hex), embedded artifacts (fw/), documentation, and benchmarks for PSOC™ Edge and PSOC™ 6.

The Model Zoo for AURIX is maintained by Infineon Automotive and is not open for general partner or community submissions for now. See the README and contribution guidelines in the corresponding repository for details on how to contribute.

boxes.heading: Get in Touch
boxes.text: Interested in becoming a partner or publishing your first project? Reach out to Infineon when you open your pull request, or contact us through Infineon DEEPCRAFT™ Edge AI Solutions to discuss your content before submitting.

Resources.title: Resources
Resources.description: Articles, blog posts, white papers, application notes, and other materials about the DEEPCRAFT™ AI Hub.
Resources.long_description: Articles, blog posts, white papers, application notes, and other materials about the DEEPCRAFT™ AI Hub—its tools, Solutions, Accelerators, and model projects—are collected here. Use these resources to learn more about what you can achieve with Edge AI: real-world applications, practical deployment examples, and inspiration for what is possible on Infineon embedded hardware. Go deeper than the catalog listings to see how others have built with DEEPCRAFT™ Studio, deployed Ready Models, evaluated Model Zoo projects, and applied edge AI across consumer, industrial, and automotive use cases.
